prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-53439
prose.body: Hi there, hope you’re having a great week! Just popping in to send a gentle nudge regarding invoice INV-53439 for 5252.89 USDC from Rowan Print. We really appreciate your business and know how busy things can get at Greywater Robotics. When you get a chance, please remit the payment to our standard wallet address: 0xfa2a4da0bf5c196b328f0ac2792c5be7fe39ab71. This is our usual address for all settlements, so you can feel safe using it as always. Let us know once it’s sent so we can update our records. Thanks a ton! Best, Rowan Print Team
